Get VTB Infobasket Best Player Parameters

Source: R/vtb.R
vtb_infobasket_best_player_parameters.Rd

Player leader categories (a code table).

Endpoint: GET https://org.infobasket.su/Widget/GetBestPlayerParameters/

Usage

vtb_infobasket_best_player_parameters(lang = "en")

Arguments

lang

Label language (en or ru). Most bodies carry both languages whatever is asked; the leader categories' labels follow it.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble: Player leader categories (a code table). The columns are always these, in this order (sportsdataverse-py vtb_infobasket_best_player_parameters); an empty valid answer raises hoopR_no_data, a valid body with no rows for this frame is a zero-row tibble:

col_nametypedescription
paramintegerLeader-category id; pass it as param to /Widget/BestPlayers or /Widget/BestTeams.
namecharacterLeader-category name, English (double spaces as sent).

Details

Source, terms of use, request pacing, seasons, ids, coverage and error classes of this family: see the notes in vtb_infobasket_seasons().

 vtb_infobasket_best_player_parameters()

See also

Other VTB Functions: vtb_infobasket_best_players(), vtb_infobasket_best_team_parameters(), vtb_infobasket_best_teams(), vtb_infobasket_box_score(), vtb_infobasket_calendar(), vtb_infobasket_coach(), vtb_infobasket_comp_issue(), vtb_infobasket_cross_table(), vtb_infobasket_game(), vtb_infobasket_game_page(), vtb_infobasket_game_staff(), vtb_infobasket_pbp(), vtb_infobasket_player(), vtb_infobasket_player_career_stats(), vtb_infobasket_player_game_log(), vtb_infobasket_player_season_stats(), vtb_infobasket_playoff(), vtb_infobasket_playoff_games(), vtb_infobasket_roster(), vtb_infobasket_roster_coaches(), vtb_infobasket_seasons(), vtb_infobasket_standings(), vtb_infobasket_team(), vtb_infobasket_team_box_score(), vtb_infobasket_team_coach_stats(), vtb_infobasket_team_comps(), vtb_infobasket_team_games(), vtb_infobasket_team_player_stats(), vtb_infobasket_team_preview(), vtb_infobasket_team_season_stats(), vtb_infobasket_team_seasons(), vtb_infobasket_team_stats(), vtb_infobasket_team_stats_coaches(), vtb_infobasket_team_stats_players(), vtb_league_leagues(), vtb_league_matches(), vtb_league_seasons()
